notes.title: σ only
notes.text: σ only: each fluorine contributes one inward-pointing 2p σ orbital, as in SF6. Its other 2p orbitals (the π set and lone pairs) are left out, so this diagram shows the σ framework only. In real BF3 the fluorine π orbitals also donate into boron's empty 2pz, which this σ-only diagram cannot show (the matcher's 'π from terminal atoms' case).
